**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

Credit and volatility neutral: HYG (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND, LQD (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -7.70%) ↓ falling but overall ratios flagged NEUTRAL.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**

**5. US vs Global?**

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation healthy: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +7.26%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.52% | 1M: +4.13%) ↑ rising; small caps weak: IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -5.14%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial and gas strength: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +1.55%), UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +7.09%), UGA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +19.41%). Gold in RECOVERY: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +0.29% | 1M: -7.92%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed/spotty: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -0.59%) while Brent BNO in CORRECTION (1W: -5.03% | 1M: +12.19%) and USO in CORRECTION (1W: -4.70% | 1M: +12.57%) show short-term pullbacks inside longer-term strength.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership (XLK and QQQ both ABOVE TREND) and strong semis (SOXX ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCES: Very narrow breadth (3/11) and commodity corrections (USO/BNO) create fragmentation — no major divergence across core ETFs (SPY/XLK/TLT consistent), so regime remains NEUTRAL.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to Tech/semis and thematic risk where momentum is confirmed (XLK, SOXX, QQQ); reduce exposure to Energy and Financials given sector weakness and narrow breadth; monitor small-cap IWM and commodity corrections closely.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +6.69%), Semiconductors SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.68% | 1M: +11.84%). BEARISH: Energy XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -0.59%) and Financials BELOW TREND (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -5.68%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Natural gas UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +7.09%), Copper CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +1.55%). BEARISH: Oil/Brent USO CORRECTION (1W: -4.70% | 1M: +12.57%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -5.03% | 1M: +12.19%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency marker) — VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -7.70%) ↓ falling; HYG/LQD ratio ~ neutral — HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -1.36%), LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -1.50%); Breadth 3/11 (watch for expansion to confirm risk-on).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, confirming a narrow market despite pockets of strength. Tech and semis showing strength (XLK and SOXX ABOVE TREND); key risk is narrow breadth plus energy/financials weakness — monitor breadth for regime shift.
